'''Phrin Shades''' lurk behind the first door of the [[Shade Catacombs]] in [[Mort'ton]]. They initially appear as dark moving shadows, known as '''Phrin Shadows''', on the ground and then rise from the depths to attack or retaliate. Their remains can be cremated with any [[pyre logs]]. The [[salve amulet]] and [[salve amulet (e)]] work well on this shade, which is very useful if shades are assigned for a [[Slayer assignment]].
